meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 把用户从空 AKS 集群带到跑起模型:按顺序核对集群、装控制器、评估 GPU、装推理提供商、部署首个模型并汇总;每步报告状态,安装/部署前先征求确认,也支持从指定步骤继续。
howto.when: 当用户说“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”等关键词,或要求为 AKS 搭建模型推理时触发;默认集群已存在,没有集群就先转给 azure-kubernetes 技能。

say.note: 会按步骤核对集群、装控制器再继续。

howto.what_en: Takes user from an empty AKS cluster to running model: verify cluster, install controller, assess GPU, install provider, deploy first model, summarize. Reports status each step, asks confirmation before installs/deploys, can resume from a step.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "setup AI Runway" or "install AI Runway", or when asked to set up model inference on AKS. Assumes an existing cluster; otherwise hands off to azure-kubernetes skill first.
